title: Encounter
description: encounters/<id>.json (spec §4.8). Documentation only: the C# loader (Tactics.Logic PackLoader and Validation) is the authority and also checks meaning (spec §4.10).

level.description: The intended party level (1..10) for balance checks.
Overrides the monster's level (only the sheet's Level changes; the stat block isn't rescaled).

variant.description: A sprite recolour: the monster's sprite key with this as its third part (beasts.wolf.dire).

tag.description: What objectives and triggers call it; defaults to the monster id.

id.description: Names this one unit in the battle (count must be 1). Without it units are numbered "<monster>.<n>" in placement order.

items.description: Placed with either at or zone.
